label: Electricity framework law
description: The principal electricity law and the laws amending it, which establish the legal basis for the other instruments in the sector.

label: National power plans
description: Official long-term plans for generation and transmission capacity, such as Indonesia's RUPTL and Vietnam's PDP.

label: Grid codes and market rules
description: Technical grid codes, network access rules and the rules governing wholesale electricity markets.

label: Tariffs and PPA terms
description: Retail electricity tariffs and the standard terms of power purchase agreements between utilities and independent power producers.

label: Renewable pricing and procurement
description: The pricing and procurement of renewable electricity: feed-in tariffs, ceiling prices, auctions and price frames.

label: Rooftop and distributed solar
description: Rules on solar installations at households, commercial buildings and industrial premises: eligibility, capacity limits, and the treatment of electricity exported to the grid.

label: Power wheeling and direct PPAs
description: Rules under which a consumer may contract electricity directly from a generator, either through transmission over the utility's network for a fee (wheeling) or through a direct or virtual power purchase agreement.

label: Captive power and licensing
description: Rules on generation for the generator's own consumption rather than for sale to the utility, such as plants at smelters or industrial parks, and the licences such generation requires.

label: Coal phase-out and early retirement
description: Restrictions on new coal-fired plants and plans or criteria for the early retirement of existing plants.

label: Energy storage
description: Rules on batteries, pumped hydro and other storage: licensing, grid connection, and storage requirements attached to renewable projects.

label: Cross-border electricity trade
description: Electricity imports and exports, interconnectors, and the licences and agreements governing cross-border power trade.

label: National energy strategy
description: Economy-wide energy strategies and master plans to which power sector rules and plans refer.

label: Energy efficiency
description: Efficiency standards, energy audits and demand-side programmes that affect energy consumption.

label: Carbon pricing and GHG rules
description: Emissions trading, carbon taxes, offsets and the greenhouse gas reporting rules on which they depend.

label: Coal supply obligations and price caps
description: Domestic market obligations for coal and caps on the price of coal supplied to power plants, which affect generation costs.

label: Electric vehicle adoption
description: Demand-side instruments for electric vehicles: purchase incentives, registration and tax treatment, adoption targets and charging infrastructure rules.

label: Critical minerals and downstreaming
description: Instruments on critical minerals: domestic processing requirements, ore export restrictions and mineral strategies.

label: Local content requirements
description: Requirements that projects, procurement or subsidised products use a minimum share of domestically produced goods or services.

label: Manufacturing incentives
description: Subsidies, tax incentives and production-linked support for manufacturing clean energy technologies and their components.

label: Foreign investment rules
description: Rules on foreign ownership, investment screening and approval that apply to energy and clean technology manufacturing.

label: Import tariffs
description: Customs duties and their exemptions on clean energy technologies, components and inputs.

label: Trade remedies
description: Anti-dumping, countervailing and safeguard duties on clean energy technologies and their inputs.

label: Import approvals and standards
description: Approved-product lists, mandatory standards and certification that determine which imported products may be sold or used.

label: Export restrictions
description: Export bans, quotas, licensing and controls on clean energy technologies, components or inputs.
